items.title: What happens as gut feel takes over from the rubric?
items.description: Back-derived directly from the worked scenario's own numbers: Candidate A scores 3 on the rubric but left a stronger first impression (worth 5 on a pure-gut basis); Candidate B scores 5 on the rubric but left a weaker first impression (worth 3 on a pure-gut basis). Drag the slider from 0% (fully rubric-driven, the structured outcome) to 100% (fully impression-driven, the unstructured outcome) to see exactly where the ranking flips.
items.compute: const rubricA = 3; const rubricB = 5; const impressionA = 5; const impressionB = 3; const w = params.gutWeight / 100; const candidateAScore = rubricA * (1 - w) + impressionA * w; const candidateBScore = rubricB * (1 - w) + impressionB * w; const scoreGap = Math.round((candidateBScore - candidateAScore) * 10) / 10; return { scoreGap };

outputs.label: Candidate B's score minus Candidate A's (positive = B ranked higher)
